reuse.why: Routes posting, preview, forecast and rule-action sync through the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, but leaves the budget schedule template on its own midpoint computation.

duplication.why: Removes four inline midpoint copies in favour of the shared helper; the copy in schedule-template.ts survives.

placement.why: The rule change is made in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, the tree's existing home for it.

scope.why: Only amount resolution sites and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: One helper now owns the rule for most paths, but the overlooked template site will silently disagree.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList still computes the ranged amount inline (midpoint) instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No new duplication; the remaining schedule-template.ts copy is pre-existing and untouched.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts is used by posting, preview, forecast and updateActions, but budget/schedule-template.ts keeps its own midpoint rule.
